review_kind: static source and existing aggregate metadata only
allowed_scope: One locally preregistered bounded historical sampling and fixed-model diagnostic execution after the exact pre-review, registration, freeze and sources are committed. No retries, additional samples, training, games or policy calls.

checks.source_selection: Independently resolved old train/validation seed order, both seats and indexed opponent through original reconstruction metadata; compared exact identities, file hashes and original manifest order.
checks.sparse_selection: Metadata-only per-game phase/class minimum-hash selection; no prediction/reward/dedup ranking; preserve original physical row and sparse step/decision identities.
checks.freeze_before_scoring: All 20 collection receipts and exact sample manifest are bound before reference scoring; full selected train support is built before validation.
checks.reporting: Saved compact-only six marginals and phase/class cells; sample-relative support, local first-per-class disagreement witnesses, no reward-causal or population claim.
checks.source_counter_failure_semantics: Completed hash/inflate/candidate work is recorded before quota/deadline failure. Physical line counters are atomic; charged parse attempts and buffered bytes are distinguished.
checks.failure_stop: Failed work retains reservations and available source receipts; killed source work without a receipt is explicitly unknown. No retry or refund.
checks.lifecycle: Reuses unchanged accepted exit-capacity Windows executor; one worker and original deadlines. Successful results require a natural contained empty tree.
checks.publication: Only code, relative identities/hashes and aggregate results/reviews. No original inputs, compact rows, witnesses, support pickle, weights, process identities or raw logs.

resolved_findings.evidence: verify_sampling explicitly adds six readback JSON rows and twelve candidates. Its expected numerical total is 13/26; pipeline conservative decode-plus-evaluate total is 27/54, giving 40/80. Fixture construction and metadata are not presented as numerical consumption.
sampling._Meter.record records all actual event fields before rejection. New in-memory cases cover expired deadline and observed candidate excess; no extra numerical fixtures.
Both focused suites receive the same worker deadline; sampler clips its local sixty-second limit to it.

history_protection.current_whitelist_sources_metadata_and_p: Stage prepare/verify checks these byte hashes; this review independently checked current source and metadata bindings, not model or historical raw bytes.
history_protection.unselected_historical_large_data: Before/after stat only; not a fresh byte-integrity claim.
history_protection.selected_original_stream_hashes: Deferred to the once-only charged collection jobs; not read by reviewer.

limits: This is execution-before-result static approval, not proof that the new tests or real source sampling pass.
The selected data are known historical demonstrations, not an independent holdout or the full opponent-seat population.
Missing classes, duplicates or no clear errors can leave diagnosis inconclusive even when integrity passes.
Original full-diagnostics failure, capacity history and policy-admission failure remain unchanged.
Local registration and commit do not constitute an external prior timestamp.
